fieldValues.title: How does a dream turn a recurring storyline into relationship strength?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised in Research (Dreamtime), 2026-10-30, as a question to explore before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. It writes evidence: each vignette that tells the storyline gets an evidences link to the record, and strength is the number of independent ones.
- B. It records the storyline itself (a cluster of vignettes) and the record derives from it.
- C. It stores a strength value, which needs a home in the data model (relation confidence was removed, 4f1e12e5).
- D. Nothing is stored: strength is computed on read from recurrence.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether recurrence found by a dream agrees with the owner's sense of what is well grounded.
fieldValues.next_action: Have one dream look for recurring storylines across the 2026-10 vignettes and compare its strongest with the owner's.
